ha_api_info.title: Connect over the HA API
ha_api_info.description:
Make sure HASS.Agent .NET10 is running on the PC and set to use the **HA API** connection.

Then open the app, go to **Danger Zone** and press **Republish discovery** — or simply restart the app.

Press **Submit** here once you have done that, and the PC will be added.

legacy_client.title: {name} runs the old HASS.Agent
legacy_client.description:
**{name}** runs HASS.Agent {version}, the original Windows client. This integration is made for **HASS.Agent .NET10** and cannot talk to the old client, so this PC was not added. Nothing on the PC was changed.

Two ways forward:

- **Update the Windows client** to HASS.Agent .NET10 (recommended) — see **Learn more** below. Once it is updated, this notice disappears and the PC is discovered again.
- **Keep the old client for now** and go back to the last legacy release of this integration: in HACS open *HASS.Agent .NET10 Integration*, choose *Redownload* and pick version `v3.0.2`. That line still works with the old client, but it is no longer maintained.

If something goes wrong with the switch, the README and the issue tracker are linked from the project page under Learn more.

outdated_client.title: {name} needs a newer HASS.Agent .NET10
outdated_client.description: **{name}** runs HASS.Agent .NET10 {version}, but this integration needs **{minimum}** or newer. Some features will not work until the Windows client is updated — see **Learn more** below. This notice disappears once it is.
